subject: Post-demo: HIPAA / BAA eligibility + next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@healthcloud.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: HIPAA / BAA eligibility + next steps

Hi Samira 

Thanks again for your time today  great conversation and appreciate the clarity on HealthCloud's PHI flows. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap from our call:
- HealthCloud will persist PHI from EHR ingestion and pass through to downstream clinician tools.
- Primary ask: vendor that can sign a BAA and support processing PHI in a dedicated or private deployment. Hosted (multi-tenant) only acceptable with complete de-identification upstream.
- Security evidentiary needs: SOC 2 attestation, encryption-at-rest/in-transit details, data residency, and answers to your vendor questionnaire.

Redwood notes / answers (high level):
- BAA: Redwood can sign a BAA for eligible deployments. Draft attached for your legal/security team to review. [Attachment: Redwood_BAA_Draft_20260707.docx]
- Eligible deployment modes for PHI: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) and Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem) are supported for PHI under a signed BAA. Hosted API (our shared multitenant endpoint) is only supported for de-identified data.
- SOC: We can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report and related attestation once mutual NDA / sharing agreement is in place.
- Questionnaire: I'm attaching our security questionnaire to help accelerate answers. I'll also loop in our security lead to handle the more technical items. [Attachment: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf]

Proposed next steps:
1) Please share your vendor security questionnaire (or confirm the questionnaire you mentioned on the call).
2) If you want, sign/return the attached BAA draft and we'll route it to our legal.
3) I'll assign Rishi (copied separately) to lead completion of the security questionnaire and SOC 2 paperwork.
4) Quick follow-up call next week to review outstanding items and timeline.

If that plan looks good, I can start the vendor intake and set expectations for a ~7-10 business day turnaround on the questionnaire answers.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124
[Attachment: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf] [Attachment: Redwood_BAA_Draft_20260707.docx]

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@healthcloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@healthcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: HIPAA / BAA eligibility + next steps

Thanks Marissa  appreciate the clear summary. A few answers from our side to help you triage: 

Short answers:
- BAA: Required. We cannot move forward with PHI processing without an executed BAA.
- Deployment mode: For production PHI, we require either a dedicated single-tenant environment or a private VPC/on-prem solution. Shared hosted endpoints are not acceptable unless the data is de-identified before it hits the vendor.
- SOC 2: We need a SOC 2 Type II report (within the last 12 months) and a short memo describing quarterly penetration testing cadence.

I've attached our standard vendor security questionnaire (spreadsheet)  it's what our InfoSec team uses. We generally expect a completed questionnaire plus any supporting docs. [Attachment: HealthCloud_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx]

Timeline: we have a procurement window the week of 7/20. If Redwood can provide the questionnaire answers and an editable BAA by 7/16, we can get legal review started. Can Rishi own the questionnaire?

I'll plan for a 30-min follow-up on Fri 7/16 to review open items  available 1012 PT.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Vendor Security | HealthCloud Inc.
samira.k@healthcloud.com | (617) 555-9987
[Attachment: HealthCloud_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx]

Perfect  thanks for the quick clarifications, Samira. 

Confirming items and next steps from Redwood side: 
- BAA: attaching editable BAA draft (same doc from my first mail). We'll prioritize legal review as soon as we have your markups.
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation. I will provide the report and a short one-page summary of our pentest cadence. If needed, we can provide redacted evidence under an NDA.
- Deployment eligibility: Confirmed  Dedicated and Private (VPC/on-prem) are the supported modes for PHI under a signed BAA. Our Dedicated offering provides reserved GPU capacity in a single-tenant environment; Private provides VPC isolation and customer-managed networking.
- Questionnaire: Rishi (cc'd) will own completion of your security questionnaire. Rishi  can you confirm estimated turnaround and whether you'll need a call with HealthCloud InfoSec?

Proposed timeline: Rishi to return completed questionnaire and SOC evidence by 7/15 so HealthCloud legal can start review by 7/16. If anything slips we'll surface it in the Fri 7/16 call.

Thanks again  happy to jump on the follow-up call if it helps.
